annotations.title: Verify a Forge Orbital decision record

description: Verifies the Ed25519 signature of a Forge Orbital demo decision record against the published demo key id. Pass the full signed record object returned by run_check (this demo keeps nothing, so a record id alone cannot be looked up). Editing any field makes verification fail. Demo records only.
